@import "tailwindcss"; /* * Brand tokens for {{ brand.meta.name }} * Generated by template-forge from assets/library/brands/.toml * * These variables sit alongside shadcn's own design tokens (--background, * --foreground, --primary, etc.) in a separate namespace. Refined TSX may * consume them directly via `var(--color-ember)`; shadcn components keep * using their own tokens unchanged. */ :root { /* Surfaces */ --color-bg: {{ brand.colors.light.bg }}; --color-surface: {{ brand.colors.light.surface }}; --color-ink: {{ brand.colors.light.ink }}; --color-muted: {{ brand.colors.light.muted or "#9BB0C8" }}; --color-border: {{ brand.colors.light.border or "#E2E8F0" }}; /* Accents */ --color-ember: {{ brand.colors.light.ember }}; --color-ember-alt: {{ brand.colors.light.ember_alt or brand.colors.light.ember }}; --color-info: {{ brand.colors.light.info or "#3B82F6" }}; /* Typography */ --font-display: "{{ brand.typography.display }}", system-ui, sans-serif; --font-ui: "{{ brand.typography.ui }}", system-ui, sans-serif; --font-body: "{{ brand.typography.body }}", system-ui, sans-serif; --font-mono: "{{ brand.typography.mono or 'ui-monospace' }}", ui-monospace, monospace; /* Safe-area insets for notch / home-bar / status-bar clearance. * Resolves to 0 on environments without the env() function or without insets. * Consumed by src/app/responsive-shell.tsx for mobile layouts. */ --safe-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0); --safe-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0); --safe-left: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0); --safe-right: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0); } /* Mobile-only top padding so notch doesn't clip the header */ @media (max-width: 767px) { html { padding-top: var(--safe-top); } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { --color-bg: {{ brand.colors.dark.bg }}; --color-surface: {{ brand.colors.dark.surface }}; --color-ink: {{ brand.colors.dark.ink }}; --color-muted: {{ brand.colors.dark.muted or "#9BB0C8" }}; --color-border: {{ brand.colors.dark.border or "#1E2A3A" }}; --color-ember: {{ brand.colors.dark.ember }}; --color-ember-alt: {{ brand.colors.dark.ember_alt or brand.colors.dark.ember }}; --color-info: {{ brand.colors.dark.info or "#60A5FA" }}; } } /* Honor explicit theme override via [data-theme="..."] */ [data-theme="light"] { --color-bg: {{ brand.colors.light.bg }}; --color-surface: {{ brand.colors.light.surface }}; --color-ink: {{ brand.colors.light.ink }}; --color-ember: {{ brand.colors.light.ember }}; } [data-theme="dark"] { --color-bg: {{ brand.colors.dark.bg }}; --color-surface: {{ brand.colors.dark.surface }}; --color-ink: {{ brand.colors.dark.ink }}; --color-ember: {{ brand.colors.dark.ember }}; }
